scope: Theorem 1.1 (Elementary positivity and a permutation witness) of the manuscript “Elementary positivity of chromatic quasisymmetric functions” (preprints/Elementary-Positivity-of-Chromatic-Quasisymmetric-Functions-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 169 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e1c6414a9ea8ce9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a deterministic terminating procedure which, given a natural unit interval graph G on [n] and σ ∈ D0 G, returns a partition θG(σ) ⊢ n such that χG(X; q) = X σ∈D0 G qginvG(σ) eθG(σ)(X). (1.2) In particular every elementary coefficient of χG(X; q) belongs to N[q]. The assertion holds as a formal symmetric-function identity, uniformly in n and G.
